text:
Tom (AE): Hey team — prepping for the PoC kickoff with Maya (payments platform) next Tue. They want a short trial (2 weeks) to validate latency and cost under a real traffic shape. Can we align on sample data size, latency buckets to optimize for, and GPU sizing + rough budget?
Alice (SalesEng): Quick q: what's the expected tokens per request and RPS during peak? That drives batching and GPU choices.
Maya (Customer): FYI — our typical prompts are ~800 tokens in + we expect 3–5K requests/day first week, ramp to ~30K/day. We care about p95 latency <500ms and predictability.
Tom (AE): budget guardrail from purchasing is ~$8k for the PoC. They want to see cost per 1M tokens and a clear runbook.
Jeff (SRE): For 800-token seqs, p95<500ms is tight on single small GPU. If we target ~100 RPS burst, suggest: dev PoC = 1xA10 (dev config, lower cost), prod-like PoC = 2xA100s or 1xH100 depending on availability. Autoscale burst to keep latency during spikes.
Alice (SalesEng): We can couple prefix caching + dynamic batching to hit latency while lowering token cost. We'll run two experiments: (A) low-latency config, (B) cost-optimized (larger batch). Need an eval set of ~200 representative prompts.
Gina (Security): Customer requires SSO for console access, audit logs, and data not leaving EU region for this PoC. Also need to confirm we can turn off model telemetry.
infra-bot: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/poc-gpu-sizing — includes templates for traffic profile, sample scripts, and IAM checklist.
Tom (AE): Maya — can you drop a 200-prompt sample (.txt or CSV) and confirm if any PII is present? Also confirm region preference (eu-west-1).
Maya (Customer): Uploading sample now. No PII, but contains some hashed IDs. Region = eu-west-1.
Jeff (SRE): Rough compute estimate: with baseline settings, 30K/day at ~800 tokens = 24M tokens/day. If we do model X quantized + batching, approximate throughput on 1xA100 = ~600–900 tokens/s sustained (depends on concurrency). For 24M/day, that's ~278 tokens/s avg. So 1xA100 could handle avg but not bursts. Recommend staging with 1xA100 + burst pool (1 extra A100) for PoC.
Alice (SalesEng): Cost estimate for 2-week PoC (infra + API + support): approx $6k–9k depending on reserved dev instance vs on-demand. If customer agrees to VPC private deployment overhead may add ~$1.5k.
Tom (AE): Success criteria we should document: 1) p95 latency <=500ms on peak test, 2) end-to-end cost <= $X per 1M tokens (we'll compute baseline), 3) quality pass on eval set (>=90% acceptance by product team), 4) SSO + audit logs verified.
Gina (Security): Also require network diagram and KMS integration steps before we spin up private infra. I can draft a short checklist.
Alice (SalesEng): I'll prepare 2 experiment configs and a traffic generator script (small snippet below) and share as a repo.
Alice (SalesEng): ```bash
# simple load profile: 100 concurrent clients, Poisson arrival
python loadgen.py --concurrency 100 --avg-rps 150 --payload sample_prompts.csv
```
Jeff (SRE): I'll validate the autoscale policy: scale up at 70% GPU util, cooldown 60s, scale down conservatively during PoC to avoid oscillation.
Tom (AE): Next steps: Alice + Jeff to produce GPU runbook and cost table by EOD tomorrow. Gina to send security checklist. Maya — we'll follow up with a short contract amendment for the PoC budget.
Maya (Customer): Sounds good — thanks.
Alice (SalesEng): noted, will post the repo link and the 200-prompt eval metrics once ready. :thumbsup:
